tolerance_declaration.source: QC-derived from US handoff comparator hints — no human-owned ts-tolerances.json exists for Run 1
tolerance_declaration.note: All tolerances below are provisional. Human-owned tolerances required before audit (UP rule). These are structural-presence tolerances: for binary/count comparators where 0 = fully compliant, k_i represents the maximum acceptable deviation before the gate blocks.

cluster_header_gap.rationale: Binary — must have all 3 cluster headers

identity_field_gap.rationale: Minor field gaps acceptable during BUILD; 3 of 18 fields missing is the threshold

dmj_step_gap.rationale: All 3 DMJ steps are required — DMJ is the application layer

guard_rail_deficit.rationale: Must meet or exceed 6 canonical stop conditions

verification_gap.rationale: Binary — numbered steps + Three Primitives Check required

measurement_sub_section_gap.rationale: All 3 measurement sub-sections required in correct format

trace_field_gap.rationale: 14-field schema must be declared, even as placeholder

orbt_transition_gap.rationale: All 4 ORBT transitions must be tabulated

certification_schema_gap.rationale: 7-field schema must be declared as placeholder during BUILD

fleet_learning_format_deviation.rationale: Column names must match canonical 7-column registry

transform_required_count.rationale: Up to 2 format transforms acceptable; beyond that indicates systematic format drift

unmapped_target_layer_count.rationale: At most 1 target layer may lack a source element

total_field_gap.rationale: Aggregate field-level deviation across all layers; 5 total gaps is the structural ceiling

dmj_table_gap.rationale: DMJ is the application layer — all 3 tables required

mapping_confidence_deficit.rationale: At least 70% of mappings should be direct

governance_identity_deviations.rationale: At most 1 identity field mismatch acceptable during BUILD

implicit_join_hop_count.rationale: Up to 2 implicit hops acceptable if semantically documented

cross_database_boundary_count.rationale: Cross-DB routing is expected in this architecture

undeclared_write_table_count.rationale: At most 1 undeclared table acceptable; tables must exist for join to be exercisable

join_chain_boundary_annotation_gap.rationale: Boundary annotations required for agent routing clarity
